plan.name: Indirect Cleaning with Tools
plan.strategy: Use a sponge or cloth to clean the egg indirectly, then transfer it to the microwave.
steps: Find the egg in the fridge or on the countertop.
Take the egg to the sink basin.
Find a sponge or cloth from the countertop, cabinet, or drawer.
Use the sponge or cloth to clean the egg in the sink basin.
Carry the cleaned egg to the microwave.
Place the egg inside the microwave.
